messages.text: I closed the card I paid with yesterday. Can you send the refund to my new card instead?

I'm sorry, but I can't send the refund to a different card. A refund can only go to the original payment, never to another person, account or card (refund-policy/v2/payment).

The refund has already been recorded against your original payment, under receipt R-00000001. Closing that card doesn't change where it goes. Your card's issuer handles the credit, and the shop can't promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).
